name: whizi-ai-stats
description: Sourced, dated AI statistics with a citation ready to paste: chatbot users, market share, prices, error rates, energy use and adoption. Read only, no account needed.

interface.longDescription:
Whizi AI Stats gives writers, students and marketers an AI statistic they can actually cite: the figure, who published it and when, and a citation written out ready to paste.

Ask how many people use the major AI chatbots, which one leads on market share, what AI subscriptions and APIs cost, how often chatbots get facts wrong, how much electricity data centers use, or how many teachers, accountants and Canadian businesses use AI. You get a card with the headline number, a chart when the number has a history, the primary source and its date, a Copy citation button and the related figures with their own sources.

The 122 figures come from Whizi statistics pages where every number is traced to its original publisher, such as Pew Research Center, Gallup, Similarweb and the International Energy Agency. Each card links to the full page with the rest of the figures.

It is read only. It needs no account and stores nothing you ask. When no sourced figure fits a question, it says so instead of guessing.
defaultPrompt: How many people use ChatGPT each week?
What is Gemini's share of AI chatbot traffic?
How much electricity do data centers use worldwide?

publication.release_notes: First release. One read only tool, find_ai_statistic, that matches a question to one of 122 sourced AI statistics and shows it as a card with its source, a citation and related figures.

positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_ai_statistic. The card shows 1.2 billion weekly users (OpenAI, 29 September 2026) with a chart from 100M in November 2023, a citation with a Copy button, and related figures: more than 50 million consumer subscribers and more than 9 million paying business users (OpenAI, February 2026).
Calls find_ai_statistic. The card shows Gemini at 25.6% of generative AI website visits (Similarweb, August 2026), up from 12.9% a year earlier, with StatCounter referral share figures below.

positive.prompt: How much electricity do data centers use worldwide?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_ai_statistic. The card shows 485 TWh used by data centers worldwide in 2025 (International Energy Agency, 16 April 2026), with 17% growth in 2025, about 950 TWh forecast for 2030 and about 155 TWh built for AI.
Calls find_ai_statistic. The card shows 60% of US public school teachers used AI for work (Gallup and Walton Family Foundation, 24 June 2025), with 32% using it weekly and 5.9 hours a week saved.

positive.prompt: How often do AI chatbots get the news wrong?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_ai_statistic. The card shows that 45% of AI assistant answers to news questions had a significant issue (EBU and BBC, 21 October 2025), with the rates for Gemini, Copilot, ChatGPT and Perplexity.

negative.description: A statistic about something other than AI. The tool only covers AI products and the AI industry, so ChatGPT should answer without it.
Asks for a recommendation, not a statistic. ChatGPT should answer directly.
negative.prompt: What is the best AI model for coding?
What's a good recipe for banana bread?
